blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – Two women of the Matigsalog ethnic group traveled more than eight hours to sell handmade native bracelets at the Diyandi Festival, the patronal fiesta celebration honoring St. Michael the Archangel. Aida Ababon, 47, and Sheila Batal, both from the Matigsalog tribe in Marilog District, Davao City, traveled by bus and arrived Saturday evening at the Tambo public terminal, where they stayed overnight. During Sunday’s Diyandi Festival, the duo sold bracelets of various designs for only P20 each.
